reason: The heated extraction head appears suited to the surveyed ice bore, the first stage of establishing the well.
expectation: The head will begin extracting water from the ice.

effect: The extraction head created a sealed melt well; the water still needs a route to treatment.
reaction: The closed, heated well is a satisfying first step.
reason: The clean service hose appears suited to carrying water from the well to the processor.
expectation: The hose will connect to the well for the treatment line.

effect: The hose connected the well to the processor, with a strainer catching raw-water grit; treatment remains to be completed.
reaction: The upstream strainer is a useful, physically sensible detail.
reason: The connected well line supplies the water processor, so using it there is the clearest next step toward treatment.
expectation: The processor will treat the water from the well.

effect: The processor produced checked drinking water, completing treatment and revealing the need to protect the exterior run.
reaction: The first cup is a satisfying payoff for establishing the water line.
reason: The insulation felt and packing foil look like complementary materials for protecting the exposed line.
expectation: They will form a protective insulating wrap for the exterior run.

effect: The foil and felt formed a flexible insulating jacket for the hose.
reaction: The overlapping seam is a satisfying practical detail.
reason: The connected well line is the exterior run that needs protection.
expectation: The insulation will wrap and protect the exposed water line.

effect: The jacket protected the heat-traced line and completed the chapter; insulation slows heat loss but does not replace the heater.
reaction: Leaving the couplings accessible and distinguishing insulation from heating were satisfying practical details.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the well through a strainer to treatment was worthwhile: the sequence made the path from cloudy meltwater to checked drinking water understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Applying the finished jacket was fairly predictable after making it, though it completed the protection goal.

surprise.text: The hose connected both the well and processor in one action, and the final explanation clarified that heat tracing still supplies heat beneath the insulation.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the materials and actions had clear purposes in the water system.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the expedition develops, especially if later chapters connect practical engineering details to similarly tangible outcomes.
